answer: Mark Rutte is the Secretary General of NATO, and yes, he is in his first term. He took office on October 1, 2024, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg as the 14th Secretary General. NATO Secretary Generals serve an initial four-year term, so Rutte is currently less than two years into his first term, which is scheduled to end on October 1, 2028.
